Class H3SimulationEngine

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.core.H3SimulationEngine
All Implemented Interfaces:
ISimulationEngine
public class H3SimulationEngine extends Object implements ISimulationEngine
H3-based simulation engine. Manages the simulation loop for the hexagonal grid system. Implements density-based simulation: - Climate updates (seasonal temperature changes) - Food resource production (seasonal, biome-based) - Population dynamics (growth/starvation) - Migration as density flow between cells
